findings.title: Fallback lookup crashes on nil default_locale
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList#[] in config/initializers/i18n.rb builds [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact. Calling to_sym before compact means a nil or missing SiteSetting.default_locale raises NoMethodError instead of falling back to :en. Because this method runs on every I18n fallback lookup, including error pages and boot/migration paths where SiteSetting may be unavailable, a single missing setting turns every translation into an exception.

findings.title: Translation cache key ignores fallback chain
findings.body: I18n.translate in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb caches with key "#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}". With fallbacks enabled the result depends also on SiteSetting.default_locale and the :en fallback. Changing the site default locale does not change the key and does not clear @cache, so requests for the same key and user locale keep returning the old fallback translation indefinitely until I18n.reload!.

findings.title: Interpolated/pluralized lookups do not load fallback locales
findings.body: I18n.translate in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb only calls load_locale(config.locale) and returns early via translate_no_cache for calls with options such as count or interpolation. It never ensures the fallback locales from FallbackLocaleList are loaded. Outside ApplicationController#set_locale, for example in background jobs, mailers, or console, I18n.t with options will report translation missing even when SiteSetting.default_locale or :en has the key, while option-less lookups from the same process may succeed.
